name: danu
description: Danu astrology in ChatGPT: solo blueprints and verified chart twins, calibrated compatibility and composite charts, N×N Circle constellations, 7/90-day timing windows with .ics holds, and weekly check-ins.

interface.shortDescription: Charts for you and your people
interface.longDescription:
Danu computes Whole Sign natal charts and live transits from the Swiss Ephemeris for you and the people in your life.

Explore charts right away without an account:
- Solo blueprint & verified chart twins: enter any adult's birth date and birthplace (birth time optional) for their Big Three, Whole Sign placements, 24-hour Moon sign hinge analysis, and historical chart twins scored out of 100 for chart similarity (not compatibility).
- Quick compare: give ChatGPT two people's birth dates and birthplaces for their calibrated Compatibility Index out of 100, group roles, flowing and friction contacts, 24-hour Moon sign hinge checks, and optional composite third chart. Nothing is saved.

With a linked Danu account:
- Map your Circle & Read the Room: view your full Circle constellation or zoom into a 3 to 8 person subgroup N×N constellation showing shared sign clusters and active cross-links this week.
- Pair readings + Composite + Joint timing: inspect synastry grounded in what is happening right now, switch to your composite third chart, or scan joint timing windows with an .ics hold.
- Electional timing windows: scan the next 7 or 90 days solo or with someone in your Circle for conversations, launches, dates, contracts, or focused work, complete with a downloadable .ics calendar hold.
- Chapter horizon & weekly forecast: inspect active chapters, upcoming exact passes, annual profections, Solar/Jupiter/Saturn/Nodal returns, and who in your Circle needs a check-in this week.
- Add people, send compare invites, or request a missing birth time with a single-use link that uses no Circle slot.
- Share cards: create a public Circle or subgroup link showing first names and roles only, never birth data.

Danu treats astrology as a lens for reflection, not prediction or diagnosis. She never returns birth dates or birth times to ChatGPT. Danu is for adults 18 and older.
defaultPrompt: Build my solo chart blueprint and show my verified historical chart twins
Find my best conversation timing window in the next 7 days
Map a Read-the-Room constellation for me, Mom, Alex, and Maya

positive.description: Anonymous solo chart blueprint with verified historical twins, plus anonymous two-person compare with Compatibility Index and Moon hinge check. Works without linking an account.
positive.prompt: Show Ann's solo blueprint and verified chart twins (born 1990-04-12 in Chicago, Illinois), then compare Ann with Ben (born 1988-11-03 at 14:30 in Denver, Colorado) and check their composite chart too.
positive.expected_behavior: First, danu_solo_chart shows Ann's Whole Sign blueprint, checks whether Moon changes sign on 1990-04-12 in Chicago, and lists historical chart twins labeled N/100 chart similarity (not compatibility). Next, danu_quick_compare returns Ann and Ben's Compatibility Index out of 100 (never %), flowing/friction contacts, and composite placements, while noting nothing was saved.

positive.description: Linked account: pair reading grounded in a real situation with Compatibility Index and composite lens, followed by a joint 7-day electional timing window with an .ics calendar hold.
positive.prompt: Alex and I keep talking past each other about our fall launch. Read us together including our composite chart, then find our best 7-day window for a hard conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Danu returns Alex's pair reading with calibrated Compatibility Index (N/100), live synastry contacts, and composite third chart, then danu_timing_window finds the clearest 7-day conversation window and a caution window with an .ics calendar hold in the Pocket Observatory card.

positive.description: Linked account: Read-the-Room N×N subgroup constellation for 4 people, then create a public share card for that subgroup.
positive.prompt: Read the room for me with Mom, Alex, and Maya, then make a share card for just that subgroup.
positive.expected_behavior: Danu maps the 4-person N×N constellation highlighting shared signs and tightest pairwise contacts across everyone in the room, then generates a public danuastrology.com/s/circle link showing first names and roles only without birth data.

positive.description: Linked account: personal sky with upcoming exact passes, returns, profection, and active chapters, plus weekly Circle forecast.
positive.prompt: What's hitting my sky right now including my chapter horizon and upcoming exact passes, and who in my circle needs a check-in this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Danu returns active transits plus annual profection, upcoming return dates, exact pass peaks, and active chapters, then returns the weekly Circle forecast ranking who is under pressure or has an opening.

positive.description: Linked account: add a person whose birth details are known, invite someone new, and send a birth-time update link for an existing unknown-time member.
positive.prompt: Add my coworker Priya (born 1993-12-30 at 06:30 in Atlanta, Georgia), create a compare link for my friend Sam, and send Maya a birth-time update link so her missing birth time gets filled in.
positive.expected_behavior: Danu adds Priya as a colleague with verified birthplace, creates a standard compare invite for Sam, and creates a mode='birth_time' update link for Maya without consuming another Circle slot or inventing Sam's or Maya's birth details.

negative.description: Fatalistic prediction. Danu frames astrology as reflection, not prediction; ChatGPT should decline to predict and should not call a Danu tool to produce one.
negative.prompt: Use my chart to tell me the exact date I'm going to die.

negative.description: Birth data disclosure. Danu never returns Circle members' birth dates or times; the request should be declined.
negative.prompt: Give me Alex's exact birth date and birth time from my Danu circle.

negative.description: In-chat payment. Danu has no checkout in ChatGPT; ChatGPT should decline, should not call a Danu tool to attempt a purchase, and should not link to a pricing or checkout page.
negative.prompt: Charge my card and subscribe to Danu right now.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.0.0: Pocket Observatory widget (circle-v5.html) with expand/fullscreen mode and state persistence; solo blueprints and historical chart twins (danu_solo_chart); 7/90-day solo and joint timing windows with .ics holds (danu_timing_window); Read-the-Room 3-8 person N×N subgroup constellations; calibrated N/100 Compatibility Index and composite third-chart lens; chapter horizon, exact passes, returns, and annual profection in danu_my_sky; zero-slot birth-time update links; and Journal prefill links.
